description: List the locations (Standorte) of the company as id and name. Locations are an optional second segmentation next to departments, useful for companies with several sites. Read-only. Call it before safe_mind_create_location to reuse existing names exactly. Requires an API key: set SAFE_MIND_API_KEY or call safe_mind_get_api_key first. Acts on the company of the account behind the key.
name: safe_mind_list_locations
